name: Rabbit hutch
about: A low wooden hutch with hay beds, and a fenced yard with flowers.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Swap the grass at the back for spruce planks: that's the hutch floor. The rest stays grass for the yard.

layers.name: Hutch and fence
layers.tip: Build the hutch walls on the floor, with a gap in the middle of the front so rabbits can hop in. Fences beside the gap are windows, and hay bales inside are beds. Fence the yard, with a gate at the front, and plant dandelions: rabbits love them.

layers.name: Roof and lights
layers.tip: Cover the hutch with spruce slabs, and put a torch on each corner post of the yard.
